title: Finite generator normalization for open scalar compatibility
statement: For an integral open operation o and a finite comparison family, each finite comparison sends the canonical finite extension-by-zero generator to the corresponding completed extension generator after scalar restriction.

source.place: Tags 03DI and 0E8I; identity on extension-by-zero summands and scalar-unit normalization.

proof.text: Evaluate the finite comparison on the direct-sum extension generator. The comparison is the identity on that summand, and the coefficient projection equations identify the restricted finite generator with the completed extension generator. Sheafification preserves this equality.

proof_origin.place: Tags 03DI and 0E8I; generator normalization on extension-by-zero summands.

lean.statement:
theorem openQuotientScalarSectionCompatibility
    (o : IntegralOpenReduction.Operations l E j)
    (finite : ∀ n : ℕ,
      IntegralOpenReduction.finiteExtension l E j o n ⋙ scalarReductionRestriction l E X n ≅
        scalarReductionRestriction l E U n ⋙ IntegralOpenReduction.extension l E j o) :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (M : normalizedDVRModules l E U n) (V : X.ProEt)
      (a : V ⟶ IntegralOpenReduction.openObject j)
      (x : M.val.obj (op ((IntegralOpenReduction.sliceSite j).obj (Over.mk a)))),
      ((finite n).hom.app M).val.app (op V)
          (IntegralOpenReduction.finiteExtensionSection l E j o n M V a x) =
        IntegralOpenReduction.extensionSection l E j o
          ((scalarReductionRestriction l E U n).obj M) V a x
